items.author: siddhichavan25
items.text:
The Rule of 7 in marketing, explained with Collagen Powder | Meta Ads for D2C

Your audience isn’t buying? Maybe you’re giving them the same reason to buy every single time.

Showing your product with a “Buy Now” CTA isn’t enough. People need to understand why they need it, what problem it solves, how it fits into their lives and why they should choose your brand.

That’s where the Rule of 7 comes in. It suggests that a potential customer may need around seven interactions with your brand before they’re ready to buy.

But that doesn’t mean showing the same ad seven times or spamming people on WhatsApp.

It means giving them a different reason to choose your product every time.

Let’s take Skin Care Collagen Powder :

❌ Show product → “Buy now!” → No context → No reason to purchase.

✅ Show the product → Highlight the problem it solves.

✅ Show the solution → Explain the pain point → Present the ideal outcome.

✅ Show someone relatable → Highlight their problem → Show how the product fits into their life.

Four creative formats. One product. Different reasons to buy.

That’s how you build a stronger customer journey instead of relying on one product ad to do all the work.

I’ve put together 10 more ad formats you can steal for your next campaign.

Comment “ADS” and I’ll send them straight to your DMs. 📩

Meta Ads is getting smarter, but does that mean your ads will automatically perform better?

With AI updates like Andromeda and Generative Ads, Meta is becoming better at understanding audiences, analysing creatives, and matching ads with potential customers.

But here's what many advertisers miss:

Better AI doesn't compensate for bad creatives.

Your targeting can be smarter, but your hook, messaging, offer, and creative still need to convince people to buy.

Stop obsessing over interests and start investing more time in your ad creatives.

The algorithm finds the audience. Your creative wins their attention.

Vorher nur Empfehlungen. Seit der Kampagne über 30 Anfragen in einem Monat.

PermaTerra baut essbare Gärten und ist fachlich top. Trotzdem kamen neue Anfragen nur über Empfehlungen, mal kam etwas, mal nichts, dazwischen stille Monate. Mein Team hat für PermaTerra Werbung aufgesetzt, die Menschen aus der Region zeigt, was PermaTerra besonders macht. Seit dem Start der Kampagne kamen über 30 Anfragen in einem Monat.

Das ist kein Versprechen, jeder Markt ist anders. Der Fall zeigt aber, wie planbare Anfragen entstehen. Als Dienstleister:in, Consultant oder Expert:in brauchst du beides. Werbung führt die richtigen Interessent:innen zu dir. Deine Marke sorgt dafür, dass sie Vertrauen haben und anfragen, bevor sie ein einziges Wort mit dir gewechselt haben.

Schick mir INFO als Nachricht, und ich zeig dir, wo du anfängst, damit neue Anfragen jeden Monat planbar kommen, statt dass du auf die nächste Empfehlung hoffst.
